page.overview:
What is Bedroom?

The is the central location in Five Nights at Freddy's 4. The Bedroom is a relatively large room. The walls of the room consist of the same blue wallpaper as the rest of the location, before splitting into a design more like that of the Closet around halfway down.

Two Doors can be seen on either side of the room. The closet can be seen directly in front, with multiple shirts hanging from the hangers above. The walls of the room are very decorated, consisting of several stars and paintings. An air vent can also be seen on the left wall.

Next to the left door, a light switch can be seen. The ceiling appears to be a simple popcorn ceiling with a single light overhead. A toy caterpillar, a blue phone, and a purple robot can be seen on the floor of the room. There are two dressers visible in the room.

The first consists of seven drawers. A few shirts can also be seen hanging out of one of them. A purple fan, a lava lamp, and an alarm clock can also be seen on top of the dresser. The second dresser consists of three drawers, and a lamp can be seen sitting on top of it.
